children.text: Intro hook: Fast-cut user quotes questioning how the algorithm knows them intimately, establishing immediate cognitive engagement.
Rapid visual transitions and dynamic text overlays: Average Shot Length < 2s prevents deep cognitive rehearsal.
Bot experiment setup: Visualizing how micro-behaviors (watch time/lingering) act as primary algorithmic signals.
Aggressive scene pacing: Continuous novel stimuli flood working memory, causing sensory overload.
Niche mapping visualization: Demonstrates algorithmic rabbit-holing based on implicit user vulnerabilities.
Depressive content deluge: Rapid succession of emotional triggers causes cognitive friction and shallow processing.
Narrowing recommendations: Algorithm narrows focus to extreme content, reinforcing transactive memory reliance.
Engagement mechanics vs. critical thinking: High-velocity delivery disables deep semantic reflection.
Conclusion on algorithmic influence: Final synthesis on how pervasive short-form algorithms hijack human attention and memory.
